about: Generated industry imagery for the Marche redesign pitch (IMAGERY lane, 2026-10-30). Twelve illustrative stills in one tenebrist mood: shot on black, one hard warm golden-yellow key light from the upper left, deep shadow to the lower right, generous black negative space for type. None stands in for a real person, place, product, brand or result of Marche; every alt describes what is depicted. Marche's own art comes from its Figma file (assets/photos, assets/brand). Run: node tools/fal-gen.mjs --plan src/content/image-plan.json --key-file <path outside the project> --concurrency 3 --cap-ultra 24.

defaults.style: no people, no hands, no faces, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no brand marks, no candy, all surfaces blank and unmarked

images.negativeSpace: left half black; bud right of centre
images.alt: A single cured cannabis bud on a black surface, its trichomes catching a warm golden light from the upper left, with a thin wisp of smoke in the dark.
images.prompt: Tenebrist editorial still-life photograph: a single dense cured cannabis flower bud resting on a black surface, its frosty resin trichomes glinting like tiny glass beads where the light lands, fine twisted orange pistils, deep green and violet calyxes, a thin wisp of pale smoke drifting through the light behind it. Composition: the bud sits right of centre and fills about a third of the frame width, wide black negative space across the whole left half of the frame. Shot in near-total darkness on a pure black background, one hard warm golden-yellow key light from the upper left in Caravaggio chiaroscuro, deep shadows falling to the lower right, crisp detail where the light lands, a subtle warm rim light on the edges, fine film grain, clean modern premium mood, accents of rich sunflower yellow and soft gold, never neon, never iridescent
